blocks.text: **Faol nisbat** (active) — ega harakatni o'zi bajaradi: Bekzod **painted** the fence — Bekzod panjarani **bo'yadi**. **Majhul nisbat** (passive) — ega harakatni bajarmaydi, harakat unga nisbatan bajariladi: The fence **was painted** — Panjara **bo'yaldi**. O'zbek tilida majhul nisbat fe'lga `-il` / `-in` qo'shimchasini qo'shib yasaladi (bo'ya**l**di, qur**il**di, yuv**il**di). Ingliz tilida esa qo'shimcha emas, ikki qismli shakl ishlatiladi: **be** + fe'lning uchinchi shakli (V3).

Eng muhim qoida: zamonni **be** ko'rsatadi, asosiy fe'l esa har doim V3 bo'lib qoladi. Demak, istalgan zamonda majhul nisbat yasash uchun ikki narsani bilish kifoya: shu zamonda **be** qanday bo'ladi va fe'lning V3 shakli qanday (noto'g'ri fe'llar — 117-dars). Asosiy qoidalar 21- va 22-darslarda o'tilgan; bu ilova — barcha zamonlarning to'liq jadvali.

rows: am / is / are going to write
**am / is / are going to be written**

blocks.text: Jadvalni qanday o'qish kerak: faol shakldagi yordamchi fe'llar (has, had, will, can...) majhulda ham joyida qoladi, ulardan keyin **be** ning kerakli shakli (be, been, being, is, was...) va oxirida V3 keladi. Shuning uchun majhul shakl faol shakldan doim bitta so'zga uzun: has written → has **been** written, will write → will **be** written, is writing → is **being** written. Jadvalda **write** ataylab tanlangan: V2 (**wrote**) va V3 (**written**) har xil, majhulda esa faqat V3 ishlatiladi.

items.text: Uzbek carpets **are sold** all over the world.
The bathroom **is being cleaned** — please wait a minute.
This film **has been watched** by millions of people.
The match **was shown** on TV last night.
When I came back, my car **was** still **being repaired**.
The cake **had been eaten** before the guests arrived.

blocks.text: **will**, **be going to** va modal fe'llar (can, could, must, should, might, have to) dan keyin har doim **be** ning o'zgarmas shakli keladi: will **be** done, can **be** done, must **be** done. «will is done», «can is done» deyilmaydi — modal fe'ldan keyin faqat infinitiv keladi, **be** ham infinitiv. (→ 27-dars — will, 30–33-darslar — modal fe'llar)

rows: They **will open** the shop at nine.
The shop **will be opened** at nine.
They **are going to change** the timetable.
The timetable **is going to be changed**.

items.text: Your new passport **will be sent** to you by post.
These boxes **can't be opened** without a key.
The rubbish **has to be taken** out every evening.

blocks.text: Inkorda **not** birinchi yordamchi fe'ldan keyin keladi: is**n't** made, was**n't** invited, has**n't** been paid, wo**n't** be finished. So'roqda birinchi yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Is** it made...? **Has** it **been** paid? **Will** it **be** finished? Majhul nisbatda **do / does / did** ishlatilmaydi — yordamchi fe'l vazifasini **be** ning o'zi bajaradi: «Does it made?» emas, **Is** it **made**?
Qachon majhul nisbat? by bilan va by siz

Majhul nisbat harakatni **kim** bajargani emas, harakatning **o'zi** yoki **natijasi** muhim bo'lganda ishlatiladi: bajaruvchi noma'lum (My phone **was stolen**), hammaga ma'lum (The thief **was arrested** — politsiya ekani aniq) yoki ahamiyatsiz. Bu shakl yangiliklar, e'lonlar, yo'riqnomalar va tarixiy matnlarda juda ko'p. Bajaruvchini aytish kerak bo'lsa — **by** («... tomonidan»): The book **was written by** a young author from Bukhara.

items: Faol gapdagi to'ldiruvchi majhul gapning egasi bo'ladi: They built **the bridge** → **The bridge** ...
**be** faol fe'l qaysi zamonda bo'lsa, o'sha zamonga qo'yiladi: built (Past Simple) → **was**.
Asosiy fe'l V3 ga aylanadi: → was **built**.
Bajaruvchi muhim bo'lsa, oxirida **by** + bajaruvchi: ... **by** a French company. Muhim bo'lmasa (they, people, someone) — tashlab yuboriladi.

items.text: The thief **was caught** an hour later.
This song **was sung by** a famous Uzbek singer.
items.translation: Bu qo'shiq mashhur o'zbek xonandasi **tomonidan ijro etilgan**.

items.text: Smoking **is not allowed** anywhere in the building.
items.translation: Binoning hech bir joyida **chekishga ruxsat berilmaydi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «The letter was wrote.» → The letter was **written** (majhulda V2 emas, V3); «This phone made in Korea.» → This phone **is made** in Korea (**be** tushib qolmasin — o'zbekchadagi `-il` qo'shimchasi inglizchada alohida so'z); «The road is repairing.» → The road **is being repaired** (yo'l o'zini o'zi ta'mirlamaydi); «I born in 2004.» → I **was born** in 2004 («tug'ilmoq» inglizchada doim majhul); «It will repaired.» → It will **be** repaired.

Eslab qolish: faol shaklning **oxirgi so'ziga** qarang. `-ing` bo'lsa (is writing) → **being** + V3; V3 bo'lsa (has written) → **been** + V3; V1 bo'lsa (will write, can write) → **be** + V3; oddiy zamonda (writes, wrote) → **is / was** + V3. V3 esa hech qachon o'zgarmaydi.
Bog'liq darslar: → 21-dars (is done / was done), 22-dars (is being done / has been done), 117–118-darslar (V3 shakllari ro'yxati).

examples.title: Present simple passive: **is made**, **are sold**
examples.description: Hozirgi oddiy zamon majhul nisbati: **am / is / are** + V3. Odatiy, doimiy harakat — kim bajarishi muhim emas.

sentences.text: Cotton **is grown** in many parts of Uzbekistan.
Russian and Uzbek **are spoken** in most shops in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdagi ko'p do'konlarda rus va o'zbek tillarida **gaplashiladi**.

sentences.text: These shoes **are made** in Italy, so they're quite expensive.
sentences.translation: Bu poyabzal Italiyada **tayyorlanadi**, shuning uchun ancha qimmat.

sentences.text: At this guesthouse, breakfast **is served** on the terrace in summer.
sentences.translation: Bu mehmon uyida yozda nonushta ayvonda **beriladi**.

sentences.text: How often **are** the rooms **cleaned** in this hostel?
The post **isn't delivered** on Sundays.
In our house, plov **is cooked** every Friday.
**Is** this cheese **made** from goat's milk?
Most of the bread in this bakery **is baked** before sunrise.
sentences.translation: Bu nonvoyxonadagi nonning ko'p qismi quyosh chiqmasdan **yopiladi**.

sentences.text: Tickets **aren't sold** on the bus, so buy one at the station first.
sentences.translation: Avtobusda chipta **sotilmaydi**, shuning uchun avval bekatdan oling.

examples.title: Present continuous passive: **is being** + V3
examples.description: Hozir jarayonda bo'lgan majhul harakat: **am / is / are being** + V3. O'zbekchada: «ta'mirlanyapti», «qurilmoqda».

sentences.text: The road to the airport **is being repaired** this month.
Sorry, your room **is being cleaned** at the moment.
A new metro station **is being built** near our house.
Look! That car **is being taken** away by the police.
**Are** the old computers still **being used** in the lab?
My laptop **is being fixed**, so I'm using my brother's.
Right now the patient **is being examined** by two doctors.
We can't use the kitchen because it **is being painted**.
In Samarkand, several old buildings **are being restored** for tourists.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda bir nechta eski bino sayyohlar uchun **qayta tiklanmoqda**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, your order **is being prepared** and will be ready soon.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, buyurtmangiz **tayyorlanyapti**, tez orada tayyor bo'ladi.

examples.title: Past simple passive: **was built**, **were invited**
examples.description: O'tgan oddiy zamon majhul nisbati: **was / were** + V3. Bajaruvchi muhim bo'lsa — **by** («... tomonidan»).

sentences.text: This bridge **was built** more than a hundred years ago.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'prik yuz yildan ko'proq oldin **qurilgan**.

sentences.text: I **was born** in Bukhara in 2003.
All the guests **were invited** to the wedding by text message.
sentences.translation: Barcha mehmonlar to'yga SMS orqali **taklif qilindi**.

sentences.text: The Harry Potter books **were written by** J. K. Rowling.
sentences.translation: «Garri Potter» kitoblari J. K. Rouling **tomonidan yozilgan**.

sentences.text: Our flight **was cancelled** because of the heavy snow.
Where **were** these lovely photos **taken**?
Nobody **was hurt** in the accident, thank goodness.
Yesterday Aziz **was stopped** by the police for speeding.
sentences.translation: Kecha Azizni tezlikni oshirgani uchun politsiya **to'xtatdi**.

sentences.text: The windows **weren't closed**, so the rain came in.
sentences.translation: Derazalar **yopilmagan edi**, shuning uchun yomg'ir ichkariga kirdi.

sentences.text: In which year **was** your school **opened**?

examples.title: **was being** + V3 and **had been** + V3
examples.description: **was / were being** + V3 — o'tmishdagi ma'lum paytda jarayonda bo'lgan harakat; **had been** + V3 — o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan oldin bajarib bo'lingan harakat.

sentences.text: When we arrived, the hall **was** still **being decorated**.
My car **was being washed**, so I took a taxi.
sentences.translation: Mashinam **yuvilayotgan edi**, shuning uchun taksiga o'tirdim.

sentences.text: At that time the old market **was being rebuilt**.
sentences.translation: O'sha paytda eski bozor **qayta qurilayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Emma felt that she **was being followed** in the dark street.
sentences.translation: Emma qorong'i ko'chada uni kimdir **ta'qib qilayotganini** sezdi.

sentences.text: By the time the firefighters came, the fire **had** already **been put** out.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar kelguncha yong'in allaqachon **o'chirilgan edi**.

sentences.text: All the tickets **had been sold** before we reached the theatre.
sentences.translation: Biz teatrga yetib kelgunimizcha barcha chiptalar **sotib bo'lingan edi**.

sentences.text: James couldn't get in because the door **had been locked**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ichkariga kira olmadi, chunki eshik **qulflab qo'yilgan edi**.

sentences.text: **Had** the documents **been signed** before the manager left?
While the bridge **was being repaired**, buses used another road.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik **ta'mirlanayotgan paytda** avtobuslar boshqa yo'ldan yurdi.

sentences.text: Madina was upset because her cake **had been eaten** by her brothers.
sentences.translation: Madina xafa bo'ldi, chunki tortini akalari **yeb qo'yishgan edi**.

examples.title: Present perfect passive: **has been** + V3
examples.description: **has / have been** + V3: harakat bajarilgan, uning natijasi hozir muhim. O'zbekchada: «sotildi», «bekor qilindi», «ochilgan».

sentences.text: Help, my wallet **has been stolen** on the bus!
The house next door **has** just **been sold**.
Have you heard? The match **has been cancelled** because of the rain.
All the emails **have been sent**, so I can go home now.
sentences.translation: Barcha xatlar **jo'natildi**, endi uyga ketsam bo'ladi.

sentences.text: **Has** the electricity bill **been paid** yet?
Our street **hasn't been cleaned** for two weeks.
Since 2020, three new parks **have been opened** in Tashkent.
I'm afraid your seat **has been given** to another passenger.
Several mistakes **have been found** in the report, so Bekzod must check it again.
sentences.translation: Hisobotda bir nechta xato **topildi**, shuning uchun Bekzod uni qaytadan tekshirishi kerak.

sentences.text: Good news — Sarah **has been offered** a job in Oxford!

examples.title: Future and modals: **will be done**, **can be done**
examples.description: Kelasi zamon va modal fe'llar: **will / be going to / can / must / should / might** + **be** + V3. Bu yerda **be** hech qachon o'zgarmaydi.

sentences.text: The exam results **will be announced** next Monday.
This medicine **must be kept** in the fridge.
Mobile phones **can't be used** during the test.
Your parcel **will be delivered** between ten and two.
**Can** this dress **be washed** in a machine?
Plastic bottles **should be put** in the yellow bin.
The new sports centre **is going to be opened** in spring.
If you don't hurry, all the good seats **will be taken**.
sentences.translation: Shoshilmasangiz, barcha yaxshi o'rinlar **band bo'lib qoladi**.

sentences.text: Dinner **might be served** a little late tonight because the chef is ill.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechki ovqat biroz kech **tortilishi mumkin**, chunki oshpaz kasal.

sentences.text: Relax — your bags **won't be lost** this time.

examples.title: Passive negatives and questions
examples.description: Inkor — birinchi yordamchi fe'ldan keyin **not**: isn't made, wasn't invited, hasn't been paid. So'roq — birinchi yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi: **Was** it **sent**?

sentences.text: **Was** your car **damaged** in the storm?
Luckily, it **wasn't damaged** at all.
**Are** you **being served**, sir, or can I help you?
sentences.translation: Sizga **xizmat ko'rsatilyaptimi**, janob, yoki yordam beraymi?

sentences.text: Why **wasn't** I **told** about the meeting?
**Have** the new rules **been explained** to the students?
The room **isn't cleaned** every day, only twice a week.
sentences.translation: Xona har kuni **tozalanmaydi**, faqat haftada ikki marta.

sentences.text: How much **will** I **be paid** for this job?
The problem **hasn't been solved** yet, so the lift still doesn't work.
sentences.translation: Muammo hali **hal qilinmagan**, shuning uchun lift hamon ishlamaydi.

sentences.text: **Is** this museum **visited** by many tourists in summer?
sentences.translation: Yozda bu muzeyga ko'p sayyoh **tashrif buyuradimi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wasn't invited** to the party, and she doesn't know why.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ziyofatga **taklif qilinmadi** va u sababini bilmaydi.

examples.title: Active or passive? Mixed practice
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bir gapda faol va majhul shakllar yonma-yon. Kim bajargani muhim bo'lsa — faol, harakatning o'zi yoki natijasi muhim bo'lsa — majhul.

sentences.text: My grandfather **planted** these trees, and now they **are looked after** by my uncle.
sentences.translation: Bu daraxtlarni bobom **ekkan**, endi ularga amakim **qaraydi**.

sentences.text: Thieves **broke** into the shop, and some phones **were stolen**.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar do'konga **bostirib kirdi** va bir nechta telefon **o'g'irlandi**.

sentences.text: The factory **produces** 500 cars a day; most of them **are sold** abroad.
sentences.translation: Zavod kuniga 500 ta mashina **ishlab chiqaradi**; ularning ko'pi chet elga **sotiladi**.

sentences.text: We **are painting** the living room ourselves — it **hasn't been painted** for years.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonani o'zimiz **bo'yayapmiz** — u ko'p yillardan beri **bo'yalmagan**.

sentences.text: Emma **was given** a lovely watch for her birthday.
sentences.translation: Emmaga tug'ilgan kunida chiroyli soat **sovg'a qilindi**.

sentences.text: Who **wrote** this song? It **was written** by a singer from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiqni kim **yozgan**? U samarqandlik xonanda **tomonidan yozilgan**.

sentences.text: They **will build** a new hospital here, and it **will be finished** in 2028.
Students **can borrow** five books, but dictionaries **can't be taken** home.
sentences.translation: Talabalar beshta kitob **olishi mumkin**, lekin lug'atlarni uyga **olib ketib bo'lmaydi**.

sentences.text: While the floor **was being cleaned**, we **waited** outside.
Tom **fixes** other people's bikes, but his own bike **has** never **been fixed**.
sentences.translation: Tom boshqalarning velosipedini **tuzatadi**, o'zinikisi esa hech qachon **tuzatilmagan**.
